source.notes: Parcels are irregular SVG polygons. NO hex grid / axial q,r in source. center/bbox are in each zone's OWN svg viewBox coordinate space (anchor-point mean; control-point overshoot ignored - approximate). Use zone-layout.json worldOffset to place zones relative to each other (source assembles zones in 3D with a 90deg X rotation; there is no single unified 2D source grid).
